title: LCLI-713 review follow-ups: gitattributes created/updated report, whitespace-variant idempotency, derived-vs-carried dedup test, and a reference note
description: Filed from opum-ai/lore-cli#571's recorded review (team-lead relay 2026-10-13). NOT part of the 0.13.1 release (LCLI-714). Four residuals: (1) src/commands/init.ts:844 reports an existing .gitattributes that only gained the docs/log.md merge=union line under created, where it belongs under updated. (2) init.ts:797's idempotency guard misses whitespace-variant forms of the line (extra or tab-separated whitespace), so a re-run can append a second equivalent line. (3) test/sync.test.ts:1307 uses fabricated hashes, so it never exercises the derived-versus-carried dedup path it is named for. (4) docs/reference has no cli-surface or contract note for the new lore init behaviour (the managed .gitattributes line, its created/updated/byte-identical outcomes). Re-read each line number at the current dev before editing; they are the review's, not re-measured here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore init on a repo whose .gitattributes exists without the line reports that file as updated, and as created only when it did not exist
lore init leaves a .gitattributes byte-identical when it already carries the union line in a whitespace-variant form, proven by a test for each variant
The sync dedup test uses hashes derived the way real entries derive them and fails when the derived-versus-carried dedup is removed
A cli-surface or contract reference note records the managed .gitattributes line and its outcomes, and lore check exits 0
